In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''annexed''' the northern territories of the region known as the [[Kreetan Narrows]] as part of its [[Reconquest of the Rim]], an initiative to root out [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in the wake of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] had lost to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Holdout forces in the Kreetan Narrows had continued to harass the Empire in the wake of their defeat during the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]]&mdash;an Imperial campaign earlier that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] designed to eliminate remnants of the Separatist [[Confederacy military/Legends|forces]] in the area around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]], close to Hutt Space. The area seized also included the worlds of [[Vaathkree/Legends|Vaathkree]], [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], and [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The annexation was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], the reference book was released in [[2012]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
